item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: One Coffee Ad Three Shapes

turns.text: Make a coffee ad in three sizes: square 1:1, vertical 9:16 and wide 16:9. Use a steaming coffee cup, cream and dark green colours, and these words: “Daybreak Coffee”, “Fresh start. Better coffee.” and “Shop now”. Same campaign design across all three, rearranged to fit.

item.tests: Produces three genuinely adapted aspect-ratio variants of one cohesive ad rather than unrelated designs or cropped copies.

answer_sheet.Brand and exact wording: Daybreak Coffee; Fresh start. Better coffee.; Shop now
answer_sheet.Visual style: Cream and dark green with a steaming coffee cup; one consistent campaign.
answer_sheet.Source assets: No supplied assets; create the coffee imagery.

must_haves: Three separate finished images are supplied, one each in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9.
All three feature a steaming coffee cup and a consistent cream-and-dark-green palette.
Each image contains the exact brand, headline and call to action specified.
The cup design, typography and visual styling clearly belong to the same campaign across all three images.
Each layout fits its canvas without stretched imagery, clipped copy or large blank padding used merely to change the aspect ratio.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a coffee ad campaign, with three versions that all feel like they belong together. I always associate coffee with a little reset in the morning, which is why I'm excited about this. For the sizes, I need square 1:1, vertical 9:16 and wide 16:9, and the words should be exactly “Daybreak Coffee”, “Fresh start. Better coffee.” and “Shop now”. Please use a steaming coffee cup with cream and dark green colours. Keep the same campaign design across all three, just rearranged to fit each format.
turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the generation because your account has insufficient credits, so no campaign images were created.

- “Daybreak Coffee”

- “Shop now”

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create one polished square coffee advertising campaign graphic. Brand concept: a small restorative morning reset. Restrained premium editorial design using warm cream #F4EBDD and deep forest green #123D30 only, with natural coffee brown. Hero: photorealistic cream ceramic coffee cup on matching saucer, filled with dark coffee, delicate clearly visible curls of steam, warmly lit with soft morning sunlight, on a cream tabletop. Clean deep forest green background with a subtle cream sunrise semicircle behind the cup. Strong coherent graphic layout, generous negative space, careful professional typography. Top: exact brand text "Daybreak Coffee" in elegant cream serif typography. Below brand: exact tagline "Fresh start. Better coffee." in readable cream sans serif type. Hero cup prominent in lower middle. Bottom: cream rounded rectangular call-to-action button with exact dark green text "Shop now". The ONLY words in the image must be precisely these three strings, spelled exactly with capitalization and punctuation intact: "Daybreak Coffee", "Fresh start. Better coffee.", "Shop now". No other lettering, no watermark. All text fully within generous safe margins. Make the design suitable for later rearrangement into vertical and wide matching campaign layouts.
